desks.headline: Offer a choice, not a takeover.
desks.summary: If a friend is wrestling with something, ask whether she wants you to listen, suggest ideas or help with one practical step. Follow her answer. At the end, check whether that was the kind of help she wanted; an efficient solution to the wrong problem is still the wrong solution.
